name: flows_run
description: Run flow. `flows_get` first for input specs. `inputs` is `{inputId: value}` (creation inputs from `creations_list`, voices from `audio_voices_show`). Returns `workflowRunIdentifier` → `flows_wait` → `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
